tweet.text:
2/ Voting works when mistakes scatter. On a math problem there are many ways to be wrong and one way to be right, so the right answer piles up.
Ten runs of one model on a long task often make the same mistake. On one benchmark, 34% of the values all ten runs agreed on were wrong.
Agreement tells you what the model believes, not what's true.
